newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fortune Cement up 5.77 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Fortune Cement up 5.77 pct in early trade.

text.p: Fortune Cement Corp gained 75 centavos, or 5.77 percent, to 13.75 pesos a share in mid-session on Thursday following the company's projection of better earnings, brokers said.
"The issue rose because of the company's projections of better earnings for this year," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
Fortune Cement disclosed on Wednesday that it expects net income to reach 1.25 billion pesos this year, up 245 percent from an estimated 1996 income of 510 million pesos.
Some 92,600 FCC shares changed hands in mid-session.
